title: FLASHVID: EFFICIENT VIDEO LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA TRAINING-FREE TREE-BASED SPATIOTEMPORAL TOKEN MERGING
reasoning: The paper is a technical research study focused on improving the computational efficiency of Video Large Language Models (VLLMs) using spatiotemporal token merging and selection techniques. It evaluates performance on standard video understanding benchmarks and contains no components related to religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
